claim_boundary: This artifact proves an exact fixed-constant norm majorant for the selected divisor comb only. It does not establish an actual finite coefficient partition, escape projection, positive transport, bounded fan, moment, density, or intervals.

divisor_comb_norm_majorant.boundary: this exact counting lemma concerns only the selected divisor comb; it does not prove an actual escape partition, negative projection, positive transport, bounded fan, moment, density, or intervals
divisor_comb_norm_majorant.cycle154_interface: this supplies the comb-norm hypothesis in Cycle 154; an actual finite labelled escape partition is still required before that cycle localizes a class
divisor_comb_norm_majorant.exact_count: for w_h(k)=Q 1_(h|k) on integer K<=k<=2K, ||w_h||_2^2/Q^2 equals floor(2K/h)-ceil(K/h)+1
divisor_comb_norm_majorant.fixed_majorant: if h<=C_h K for a frozen fixed C_h>0, the exact count is at most K/h+1 and hence ||w_h||_2^2<=(1+C_h)KQ^2/h
divisor_comb_norm_majorant.special_case: if h<=K, take C_h=1 and the fixed majorant constant is A=2

remaining_target.statement: construct or reject Cycle 155's actual exact fixed finite reason-labelled coefficient-escape partition; then Cycle 154 localizes a class with this now-fixed norm constant
